imgpath.label: Image Path
imgpath.help: Path to your images in the uploads folder.

gpxfile.label: GPX-File
gpxfile.help: The GPX-file in your GPX-directory (see Admin Settings)

requiregps.label: GPS-Data in Image required
requiregps.help: Show image only if it provides GPS-Data in its EXIF

ignoresort.label: Ignore Custom Sort
ignoresort.help: Ignore custom sort even if provided by Wordpress. Sort ascending by date taken if checked

sortorder.label: Sort Order
sortorder.help: Define the sort Order of Files

options.label: Define the sort Order of Files

filefilter.label: File Filter
filefilter.help: Define a simple Filter for Files given by imgpath

showcaption.label: Show Caption
showcaption.help: Show the caption in the fotorama slider

shortcaption.label: Short Caption
shortcaption.help: Shorten Caption to first line only

maxwidth.label: Max Width of Container
maxwidth.help: Maximum width of the whole container with slider and map in px

minrowwidth.label: Minimum row width
minrowwidth.help: Minimum width of one row (slider or map) of the CSS-Grid in px

options.label: Select how to fit the images

ratio.label: Width / Height (Aspect) Ratio
ratio.help: Define the width / height ratio of the slider

transitionduration.label: Transition Duration
transitionduration.help: Duration of slide transition in ms

loop.label: Loop through images (proceed with first once reached the last)

autoplay.label: Autoplay
autoplay.help: Autoplay the slider. On with true or any numeric interval in milliseconds. Of with false

mapheight.label: Maximum Height of Map
mapheight.help: Max. Height of the leaflet elevation map in px. Mind the relation to Aspect Ratio of Map.

mapaspect.label: Width / Height (Aspect) Ratio
mapaspect.help: Define the width / height ratio of the Map

showadress.label: Show Address
showadress.help: Show start adress of the tour

adresstext.label: Start Address Text
adresstext.help: Text for header above start address

dload.label: Allow Download GPX-File
dload.help: Provide download link for the GPX-Track(s)

trackwidth.label: Track Width
trackwidth.help: Width of the GPX track line.

trackcolour.label: Track Colour
trackcolour.help: Color of the GPX track line.

showalltracks.label: Show All Tracks
showalltracks.help: Display all GPX tracks on the map.

gpxpath.label: GPX-Path
gpxpath.help: Path to file(s) with GPX-Track(s) relative to the Wordpress uploads folder

showchart.label: Show Elevation Chart
showchart.help: Show the elevation Chart or not.

charttype.label: Chart Type
charttype.help: The type of elevation chart to display.

chartheight.label: Height of Chart
chartheight.help: Height of the leaflet elevation chart in px (is recalculated in Browser. Might show no effect if too big.)

chart_fill_color.label: Chart Fill Colour
chart_fill_color.help: Fill color for the elevation chart. NEW from here!

chart_background_color.label: Chart Background Colour
chart_background_color.help: Background color for the elevation chart.

sw_thumbbartype.label: Thumbnailbar Type
sw_thumbbartype.help: Select Swiper native Thumbbar or special Thumbbar.

navwidth.label: Thumbnails bar width
navwidth.help: Width of Thumbnails bar in Percent of Slider width.

f_thumbwidth.label: Thumbs Width
f_thumbwidth.help: Width of single Thumbnail in px

thumbbordercolor.label: Thumbs Border Colour
thumbbordercolor.help: Colour of Thumbnails Border as CSS Hex Color

sw_bar_margin_top.label: Margin above Special Thumbbar in px
sw_bar_margin_top.help: Margin above Special Thumbbar in px.

sw_button_color.label: Arrow Colour
sw_button_color.help: Color of the Arrow on Slider to change Slide.

sw_zoom.label: Activate Zoom on Slider
sw_zoom.help: Activates the Zoom Function within the Swiper Slider.

sw_hashnavigation.label: Activate Hash Navigation for Swiper
sw_hashnavigation.help: Enables the option to use a page-link to a dedicated image.

sw_max_zoom_ratio.label: Set the Zoom Ratio for Swiper Zoom
sw_max_zoom_ratio.help: Defines the Zoom ratio for the Swiper Zoom Effect.

alttext.label: Alt-Text
alttext.help: Alltext for the whole slider for SEO
